title: Typewriter and Ledger
author: Juniper Halloran
blurb: Beatrix Eastwick, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the ice breaks on the river.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
